outcome.population: ground releases seated by the snapshot chooser with a front man, the front man of record the first body
outcome.sentence: MISREAD — the chosen option is snapOpen on ≥ 0.5 of them ⇒ the chooser does not see the man in front as a threat; ⇒ M-OP.5 (the chooser seat) is drafted by the commander under 甲 — its form follows the census's answer to WHY (his eta, his facing, his staleness).
outcome.rule: on STORED point shares of OUTCOME_ARM: MISREAD if open ≥ 0.5; else BEST OF A BAD SET if shut ≥ 0.5 AND allShut given shut ≥ 0.5; else NEITHER (a share that is not a number is never ≥ 0.5); the 95 % cluster-bootstrap intervals are stored beside and select nothing

literals.MISREAD: MISREAD — the chosen option is snapOpen on ≥ 0.5 of them ⇒ the chooser does not see the man in front as a threat; ⇒ M-OP.5 (the chooser seat) is drafted by the commander under 甲 — its form follows the census's answer to WHY (his eta, his facing, his staleness).
literals.BEST OF A BAD SET: BEST OF A BAD SET — the chosen option is snapShut on ≥ 0.5 of them AND every executable option was snapShut on ≥ 0.5 of those ⇒ the chooser saw him and had nothing better ⇒ STOP: a human gate — 「没有好线 时要不要宁可不传」 is the user's (the #430 pass-or-keep rule).
literals.NEITHER: NEITHER ⇒ the commander decides with the table and says why.
